title: Allowed Amount of a Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Month Paid in Full
content:
# Allowed Amount of an Equipment Month Paid in Full — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Calculation.** The allowed amount of a Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month that the coverage paid in full is the month's fee multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule, divided by 100, rounded once to the cent, half up. The month's fee is the class's stationary monthly fee.

## Inputs and where they come from

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| stationary monthly fee | the product's fee schedule, for the class on the oxygen record |
| allowed percentage of the fee schedule | the coverage class of the coverage the oxygen record names |

## Order of the calculation

1. Take the class's stationary monthly fee as the month's fee.
2. Multiply it by the allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divide by 100.
3. Round once, to the cent, half up. No figure is rounded before this point.

## Worked examples (hypothetical allowed percentages)

**A.** Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431), allowed percentage 96. Month's fee: 172.61. Multiplied by 96 and divided by 100: 165.7056. Rounded half up to the cent: 165.71.

**B.** Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390), allowed percentage 100. Allowed amount: 172.61.

**C.** Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434), allowed percentage 85. Multiplied by 85 and divided by 100: 146.7185. Rounded half up to the cent: 146.72.

## Points of judgement

**Where does the rounding happen?** Once, on the final allowed amount, to the cent and half up.

**Which coverage class supplies the allowed percentage?** The class of the coverage the oxygen record names.
